title: Three-index Europe-open inventory drift transfer
user_boundary: The repository patch is closed and pushed, and the user instructed the original continuous Live-derived Optimization research to continue. A genuinely new clue may take one serial Lab detour, but grants no Live replacement, deployment or promotion authority.

research_height.transfer_path: A literature-fixed overseas-participant-arrival hour must survive four pre-latest blocks, three related cash-index CFDs, doubled spread and a signal-unseen latest veto before one indivisible additive Optimization seed can exist.

central_question: Does the New York Fed's fixed positive 02:00..03:00 ET S&P 500 futures drift transfer to profitable doubled-spread LONG economics as one simultaneous 0.01-lot US30+US100+US500 CFD bundle, broadly enough across periods, symbols, weekdays and months to justify one later Optimization seed?
economic_hypothesis: Inventory resolution and demand for immediacy when European participants arrive should create a positive one-hour long drift. The exact fixed bundle must be positive and efficient in initial and confirmation blocks, broad across every symbol and most weekdays/months, concentrated in neither a few days nor one isolated period, and not materially reverse in June-July 2026.

why_now.optimization_state: The 59-dimensional internal formula surface, both exact interaction clues and the later cash-close continuation transfer are closed with no successor. The fixed paired-month development candidate remains attributable but has no independent ready internal-axis successor.
why_now.independent_source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York research fixes the 02:00..03:00 U.S. Eastern long interval and a European-participant inventory mechanism before this repository's price or spread outcomes are opened.
why_now.information_value: The rule supplies three deterministic one-hour starts per eligible day without changing any existing signal formula, portfolio weight, risk gate, stop or exit.
why_now.decision_if_true: Retain exactly one indivisible US30+US100+US500 02:00..03:00 ET LONG information seed. Only a later separately declared Optimization proxy may test shared-account economics.
why_now.decision_if_false: Close the exact Europe-open drift transfer with no time, direction, DST, symbol, weekday, month, volatility, weighting or integration rescue.

literature_anchor.title: The Overnight Drift
literature_anchor.publisher: Federal Reserve Bank of New York
frozen_facts: The paper identifies 02:00..03:00 U.S. Eastern as the largest positive S&P 500 futures hour, approximately 1.48 basis points per day or 3.7 percent annualized in its sample.
The sign is reported positive in 20 of 23 years, all weekdays and all months, with significance in 17 years and nine months.
The proposed mechanism is inventory resolution and demand for immediacy around arrival of overseas traders.
literature_anchor.transfer_limit: This unit tests the exact main fixed Eastern-time hour only. It does not claim futures-CFD equivalence and does not search the paper's asynchronous Europe/U.S. DST adjustment.

literature_anchor.title: The Overnight Drift in U.S. Equity Returns
literature_anchor.publisher: Federal Reserve Bank of New York Liberty Street Economics
literature_anchor.frozen_role: Public mechanism summary; no repository outcome, clock or threshold is selected from it.

distinction_from_closed_work.unit_071_server_calendar_drift: Unit 071 decomposed previous-server-calendar-last to current-server-calendar-first gap versus current-date intraday return and found the gap supplied only 16.96 percent. Unit 109 does not reopen that gap, alternate day boundary or its rejected overnight sleeve: 02:00..03:00 ET is a continuous same-New-York-date H1 segment inside Unit 071's broad intraday remainder, selected by new external-market evidence rather than Unit 071 outcomes.
distinction_from_closed_work.unit_063_all_slot_clock_shape: Unit 063 measured native US30 M30 evaluation density and retained the native 13:30 clock; it did not trade an unconditional three-index 02:00..03:00 ET bundle, compute bid/ask economics or use a European-participant mechanism.
distinction_from_closed_work.unit_042_dst_mismatch: Unit 042 compared portfolio births during U.S./Europe DST mismatch intervals. Unit 109 fixes America/New_York 02:00..03:00 on every eligible weekday and explicitly excludes any mismatch subgroup or clock remap.
distinction_from_closed_work.unit_065_drift_attribution: Unit 065 attributed existing portfolio daily returns to a broad market benchmark. Unit 109 creates a new fixed one-hour external-market entry path and does not change benchmark, exposure or sizing.
distinction_from_closed_work.unit_108_cash_close_momentum: Unit 108 used each symbol's prior-close-to-15:30 sign and traded continuation through the cash close. Unit 109 is unconditional LONG, uses no price signal, includes US500 and trades a different literature-fixed external-market hour.

input_freeze.copy_mode: One-time byte-equal physical copy from a closed Optimization market snapshot into this Lab family's ignored raw input root; no link and no later cross-family read.

fixed_bundle.eligible_day: Monday-Friday with exact same-date 02:00 and 03:00 ET H1 opens on all three symbols.
fixed_bundle.direction: LONG on all three symbols without a signal threshold.

fixed_cost_proxy.gross: Midpoint-to-midpoint long P/L times contract size and volume.
fixed_cost_proxy.observed: Executable entry ask to exit bid; must equal gross minus one half of entry-plus-exit spread burden.
fixed_cost_proxy.stressed: Gross minus the full entry-plus-exit spread burden; binding doubled-cost measure.
fixed_cost_proxy.drawdown: Simultaneous three-leg daily bundle closes at 03:00; closed drawdown is peak-to-trough cumulative bundle USD divided by the fixed $100 starting balance.
fixed_cost_proxy.tester_limit: This proxy excludes commission, swap and native floating path. A retained seed alone could justify later dedicated non-Master native Tester economics.

opened_before_declaration: UTC/New_York exact-hour geometry, date counts, weekdays and months
not_opened_before_declaration: profit factor, drawdown, concentration, gate or verdict

economic_gates.p1: Positive bundle, both calendar splits and every symbol; PF >=1.05, net/DD >=1.25 and at least 4/5 positive weekdays.
economic_gates.confirmation: P2, P3 and P4 each positive; pooled PF >=1.05, net/DD >=1.25, every symbol pooled positive, at least 7/9 positive symbol-period cells and at least 4/5 positive weekdays.
economic_gates.prelatest: PF >=1.075, net/DD >=1.50, nominal/practical DD <=20.0%/21.2%, at least 28/46 positive months and top-five positive-day share <=35%.
economic_gates.latest: Nominal net >=$0; practical floor is no worse than one-quarter of positive P1-P4 average daily edge times latest days; full path net >$0 and PF >=1.05.
economic_gates.retention_limit: At most one exact indivisible bundle seed.
